about_the_game:
Game Introduction

You are an investigator, assigned by the company to investigate a space where strange events have occurred and retrieve anomalous objects. Of course, everything you scavenge during this process is yours to keep. The company will turn a blind eye, but is there really such a simple good deed?

Gameplay

This is a third-person action game where beautiful women fight against eerie invasions, integrating elements such as shooting, skill combat, exploration, PVE combat against scavenging and retreating, free survival, driving, and customization.

Multiplayer

Multiplayer with friends to freely explore and jointly combat the eerie invasions! Experience a different kind of fun! Game Features It provides four distinct female protagonists with different guns, skills, and outfits. Each protagonist offers 11 unique skills suitable for different types of players. Each protagonist has their own unique gun shooting, with each firearm carefully tuned for a sense of play and handling. It provides tense and exciting PVE combat against scavenging and retreating on independent maps, exploration, and retrieval of supplies! It offers vehicle driving fun. It provides a free exploration of open maps. It features eerie objects with unique "abilities," try to collect them to strengthen yourself! PVE Combat Scavenging and Retreating! It offers three independent PVE combat maps, try to find solutions and retrieve supplies for an escape. Of course, the "eerie" will do their best to prevent you from leaving the eerie space.

Free Exploration Maps

When you want a leisurely vacation, scenery, and relaxation, it provides free exploration maps that are completely different each time they unfold!

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-9100 / AMD Ryzen™ 3 3200G
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce GTX™ 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon™ RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 2080 8GB / AMD Radeon™ RX 6700 XT 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: 这是一款第三人称美女对抗诡异入侵的游戏，融合了射击，技能战斗，探索，搜打撤PVE对抗，自由生存，驾驶元素，换装等多元素融合的全新【PVE对抗搜打撤】游戏。
